annotation.title_clean: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework, Second Edition
annotation.title_en: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework, Second Edition
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Info-communications Media Development Authority (IMDA) and Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC), Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Singapore's voluntary Model AI Governance Framework (2nd edition, January 2020) gives private-sector organisations practical guidance for deploying AI responsibly. It covers internal governance, the level of human involvement in AI-augmented decisions, operations management (data, robustness, explainability) and stakeholder communication, with industry examples. It is sector-agnostic and has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four areas: internal governance, human involvement in decisions, operations management, stakeholder communication
Human-in-the-loop, human-over-the-loop and human-out-of-the-loop models, chosen by risk and harm severity and reversibility
Good data accountability practices, including separate training, testing and validation datasets and bias checks
Measures for robustness, reproducibility, explainability and auditability
Algorithm audits only at a regulator's request, as part of a forensic investigation
